name: GoHighLevel
description: Comprehensive CRM, marketing, and sales automation platform for agencies and businesses.

evidence.claim: HighLevel provides a comprehensive REST API platform with OAuth 2.0 authentication supporting contacts, messaging, calendars, payments, and webhooks.
V1 APIs reached end-of-support on December 31, 2025; V2 is the standard.
The LeadConnector MCP server securely connects MCP-compatible AI assistants to HighLevel CRM.

notes: V1 APIs reached end-of-support on December 31, 2025; integration should be built using V2 APIs and OAuth 2.0 or Private Integrations. GoHighLevel also provides an official LeadConnector MCP server.
